title: elxr
brief: asx8678's own repo, built after burning through tokens fast. Context is thin, but it reads as a token-efficiency tool from someone feeling the pain directly.
details: Elxr Fabric (asx8678/elxr) — "native Elixir foundations for long-running, cache-efficient, independently verified coding agents." An experimental research codebase (from the CheapInfra community's own asx8678) exploring how to make agents reliable over long horizons: governing boundaries are WorkCell (correctness), Context Epoch (prompt efficiency), and an append-only typed event log (truth). The current vertical slice implements canonical event hashing, parent-linked storage, typed semantic turn commits, bounded certified child handoffs, deterministic reducers, verified snapshots, fixed-section 32KiB checkpoints, integrity-bound recall, and OpenAI/Anthropic cache plans — plus a fail-closed checked-code sidecar prototype and a measurable long-horizon research loop (`./autoresearch.sh`). Very much infrastructure research, not a product. Apache-2.0.
